task: Write a Python function collect_tags(item, tags=None or similar) that appends the item's tags to an accumulator list and returns it, usable across repeated calls.

constraints.text: default argument values stay immutable; accumulators default to None with in-function assignment
constraints.why: a shared-list default corrupted session state across users in April

constraints.text: None sentinels are tested with 'is None', never with truthiness or ==
constraints.why: a truthiness check treated an empty caller-supplied list as missing and silently replaced it during the April tag-merge bug hunt
